verdict.rationale: Lever has an onboarding module that automates I-9 verification, form creation and tax documents. It also offers an integration marketplace and webhooks/API that could carry hire data downstream. However, nothing shows a signed offer automatically handing off to onboarding, or any named HRIS or payroll integration syncing new-hire records without re-entry. Missing for 10: documented offer-to-onboarding handoff, named HRIS/payroll connectors, field-level data sync without re-entry, independent or hands-on corroboration.
